ADR 0020 still lists the frontmatter tools as complete against 'real runtime usage (Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebFetch, SlashCommand, Write, Skill, Task/Agent)'. CAM-254 proves SlashCommand is not a real tool and Skill is never a valid tools: entry. Out of this story's scope (orchestrator persona file only) and ADRs are point-in-time records, so non-blocking, but the ADR's factual claim is now stale and could seed the same mistake again in a future frontmatter audit.
